notePw.title: Note password
notePw.needsVault: Only a note saved in the vault can have its own password. Save it to the vault first.
notePw.lockWarning: This note will be locked with a password of its own. Nobody can open it without that password: not Lumen, not a backup, not sync. If you forget it, the note is lost — there is no recovery key. Its earlier versions in history are deleted, because they are plain text.
notePw.newMessage: At least {n} characters. Keep it somewhere safe: it can't be recovered.
notePw.tooShort: The password needs at least {n} characters.
notePw.mismatch: The two passwords are different. Try again.
notePw.locked: The note is locked. It stays open until you lock it again or close Lumen.
notePw.unlockMessage: This note has its own password.
notePw.wrong: Wrong password, or the note was changed outside Lumen.
notePw.failed: The note could not be opened: {error}
notePw.openMessage: This note is locked with its own password and is open now.
notePw.remove: Remove the password (save as plain text)
notePw.removeConfirm: The note will be saved as plain text again, readable by anyone who can open the vault. Continue?
redact.empty: Select the text to redact first.
settings.keepImageMetadata: Keep photos' location, time and camera details (when adding photos and when exporting)
